# EAR_VAE2 Notice

`src/open_qwen_music/render/source_spec_vae.py` adapts the public EAR_VAE2 implementation:

- Project: https://github.com/Eps-Acoustic-Revolution-Lab/EAR_VAE2
- License: Apache-2.0
- Source revision: `bcbd9e1dacebb494ed9c8a4e9f36338c9de5d03b`
- Source file: `ear_vae2/model.py`

No upstream model weights are included in this repository. Open-Qwen-Music changes the interface, ragged masks, STFT boundaries, and training integration. This adaptation is not an official EAR_VAE2 release. The upstream license is included in `third_party/LICENSE-EAR_VAE2.txt`.
